chunks: And along with his saying, peace be upon him and his family:
"There is no harm and no reciprocation of harm in Islam."

key_terms.إِضْرَارَ: causing harm in return or deliberately inflicting harm
key_terms.ضَرَرَ: harm, injury, or damage inflicted upon oneself or another
key_terms.فِي الْإِسْلَامِ: within the framework and rulings of Islam

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "There is no harm and no reciprocation of harm in Islam" mean?
ai.summary: This report cites the well-known statement of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله: "There is no harm and no reciprocation of harm in Islam." In Shia fiqh, this wording is a foundational principle indicating that the Shar'i order does not validate harmful conduct or injury between people.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5718 - With the statement of the Prophet (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family:
"There is no harm and no reciprocation of harm in Islam."
